description: This file defines a mock class 'floatingRtFunctionsMock' for unit testing, using Google Mock. The mock class inherits from 'floatingRtFunctionsImpl' and provides mock implementations for several remote function methods related to remote object location, environment handling, shutdown, initialization, processing, and error string retrieval.

classes.name: floatingRtFunctionsMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'floatingRtFunctionsImpl' with mock methods for remote function operations.

methods.name: rtRemoteLocateObject
methods.description: Mock method for locating a remote object.

methods.name: rtEnvironmentGetGlobal
methods.description: Mock method for getting the global remote environment.

methods.name: rtRemoteShutdown
methods.description: Mock method for shutting down the remote environment.

methods.name: rtRemoteInit
methods.description: Mock method for initializing the remote environment.

methods.name: rtRemoteProcessSingleItem
methods.description: Mock method for processing a single remote item.

methods.name: rtStrError
methods.description: Mock method for retrieving the error string corresponding to an rtError code.
